item.title: Opening Reception of David Castillo X Studio Lenca
item.description: Miami, FL - December 2, 2025 - David Castillo presented a solo exhibition of new paintings by Studio Lenca, the UK-based artist known for work rooted in personal narrative and cultural memory. Drawing from his own experiences, Studio Lenca explored themes of joy and belonging while challenging dominant cultural frameworks. item.title: Design Miami 2025
item.description: Miami, FL -December 3, 2025 - Design Miami opened to the public, marking the start of its 21st edition at Pride Park. The fair launched its “Make. Believe.” curatorial theme with more than 70 global exhibitors, including over two dozen first-time presentations. Galleries, special projects, and site-specific installations drew crowds throughout the day, setting the tone for a strong return during Miami Art Week. item.title: Art Basel Miami Beach 2025
item.description: Miami, FL - December 3, 2025 - Art Basel Miami Beach 2025 arrives with bold ambition, uniting the creative forces shaping the future of art across the Americas and the world. This year’s 23rd edition gathers 283 leading galleries from 43 countries at the Miami Beach Convention Center, spotlighting the cultural currents, histories, and innovations that define the American art landscape within a global dialogue. item.title: Factory Basel 2025 – Night 1
item.description: Miami, FL - December 3, 2025 - Factory Basel kicked off last night, igniting Miami Art Week with its biggest and most immersive edition yet. This year, Factory Basel returns to Factory Town thru December 7, transforming the venue into a five-stage, five-day marathon of world-class music that runs straight until sunrise.
